g.title: ReviewWise
g.text: ReviewWise M3 — local weekly review reports

g.title: cluster_local
g.text: USER'S COMPUTER — reviews stay inside this boundary

g.title: browser
g.text: Paste text or upload CSV; dates user-supplied

g.title: worker
g.text: UI polls live snapshots; duplicate runs rejected
Stop event closes the streamed model response

g.title: saved
g.text: Local disk; validate imports; recompute counts
Open genuine reports without model inference

g.title: python
g.text: Up to 1,000 reviews; numbered original passages

g.title: python->ollama
g.text: up to 4 short reviews + schema; streamed response

g.title: session
g.text: Session cache lost on restart / Start over

g.title: cache
g.text: Key: text + model digest + prompt + schema + options
Retry reuses completed work; Start over clears it

g.title: prompt
g.text: At most 2 CPU threads; short context 2,048

g.title: validate
g.text: Python validates review IDs + category + unit IDs
Quotes copied from original text and rechecked
Invalid group isolated; bad reviews listed
Semantic interpretation can still be wrong

g.title: count
g.text: Python: category → set of review IDs

g.title: report
g.text: Partial download; up to 3 supported actions

g.title: weights
g.text: Ollama model files on local disk

g.title: setup
g.text: Bundled Python + hash-locked packages on Windows
WinGet: missing Ollama only; model download
Interface opens while AI setup runs in background

g.title: internet
g.text: WinGet community source / python.org / Ollama installer
PyPI + package files / Ollama model registry
Network metadata only; no review text

g.title: secrets
g.text: No API keys or secrets required
